Photos & roster

Incoming House members already have their official photos, from the 120th New Member Pictorial Directory (Committee on House Administration) and the NMO new-member cheat sheet. Every member has a photo. To replace one, click it. Load a batch with the button below, or click any empty slot to add one person.

Files are matched by name. Use either the member's Bioguide ID (for example S000033.jpg, the naming used by the House, Senate and the Congressional Bioguide) or their name (josh-turek.jpg or Josh Turek.png).

Photos you add are saved in this browser only. The built-in House photos show for everyone you share the quiz with.

Only declared winners are included (plus Victoria Broderick, TN-4, after Rep. Scott DesJarlais conceded on Nov. 16): members who lost, retired or ran for another office are left out. Incoming House members and photos: 120th New Member Pictorial Directory (Committee on House Administration, Nov. 4, 2026) and the NMO new-member cheat sheet (Nov. 7). Race calls: The Associated Press for close and late-called races (as of Nov. 20), DemList's list of called House races and congress120.com for the rest. Returning members' details: unitedstates/congress-legislators. Bio clues are written by Sources Say from facts in the House directory, a public-domain U.S. government publication; every clue was checked against the directory three times. Check names against the House Clerk's and Senate's official lists after swearing-in.
